reviewed_by: Claude Code after independent subagent root-cause validation and scratch-Core reproduction
reason: Hosts without pidfd (a Python built without os.pidfd_open, older kernels, sandboxes refusing the call) could not spawn any worker, and could not retire a frozen project worker. process_identity now keeps pidfd where it works and otherwise re-reads the recorded kernel birth before each signal; spawn no longer requires pidfd. Selected: the process identity suite (pid reuse, frozen session kill, probe) and the runtime process suite, whose frozen/exited/never-force-retired tests now run with and without pidfd.
exclusions: No UI, native or Playwright layer: no operator-visible interface changes; macOS local Core stays refused at startup and is not exercised.
